stb_image v2.30, unmodified upstream header, pinned to
https://github.com/nothings/stb/tree/f58f558c120e9b32c217290b80bad1a0729fbb2c

Used under its MIT license (included at the end of stb_image.h).
The firmware wrapper enables PNG/JPEG/BMP memory decoding only, bounds input
size/dimensions/allocations and supplies UEFI AllocatePool/FreePool.
